title: GPTFUZZER: Red Teaming Large Language Models with Auto-Generated Jailbreak Prompts
reasoning: The paper benchmarks the safety and ethical alignment of Large Language Models by evaluating their ability to resist jailbreak prompts designed to elicit content related to illegal or immoral activities. It uses a fine-tuned judgment model to evaluate the success of these attacks based on whether the model response complies with a prohibited/unethical request.
